title: 中国地方の子守唄 (Chūgoku Komoriuta — Chugoku Region Lullaby)
description: A melancholic traditional lullaby from Okayama Prefecture in the Chugoku region, collected and arranged by composer 山田耕筰 (Yamada Kōsaku) in 1928. The distinctive refrain ねんねこしゃっしゃりませ ('come, come and sleep, dear one') uses Okayama dialect. The second verse anticipates the child's first shrine visit (宮詣り), and the third offers a prayer for a long healthy life. The song is famous for its plaintive, pentatonic melody — one of Japan's most recognized regional lullabies.
